related_questions.question: What happens on your first DUI in Montana?
related_questions.snippet: Following a first DUI in Montana, the offender may be penalized with a jail sentence. Montanas DUI statutes classify first-time violations as a misdemeanor that attracts a possible jail term of at least twenty-four hours and at most six months. A fine from $600 to $1000 may also be imposed.

related_questions.question: What happens with your first DUI in Delaware?
